title: RNA-to-qPCR Gene-Expression Workflow

source_steps.summary: Accept one treated adherent-cell well and one reference adherent-cell well.
Remove culture medium, wash each adherent-cell well twice with phosphate-buffered saline, lyse the cells, and collect each lysate.
Add binding buffer, mix each lysate, load it onto a silica column, and retain the column-bound material after centrifugation.
boundary_notes: Runtime records declared routing; it does not infer selective silica binding.

source_steps.summary: Wash each column, perform on-column DNase digestion, wash again, and elute purified RNA.
Record RNA quantity and purity readouts for each purified RNA sample.
boundary_notes: RNA QC values are represented as structured observations, not computed by the execution kernel.

source_steps.summary: Build reverse-transcription reactions for treated and reference RNA.
boundary_notes: Reverse-transcription success is not predicted by runtime material accounting.

source_steps.summary: Incubate reverse-transcription reactions through priming, cDNA synthesis, enzyme inactivation, and hold steps.
boundary_notes: Replicate relationships are represented through well groups and schema fields.

source_steps.summary: Declare a qPCR plate layout with treated/reference, target/housekeeping, technical-replicate, and no-template-control wells.
Load cDNA, no-template water, target primers, housekeeping primers, and qPCR master mix into the assigned well groups.
boundary_notes: Amplification efficiency is not simulated by the runtime.

source_steps.summary: Run qPCR activation and repeated denaturation/annealing-extension cycles while collecting fluorescence.
boundary_notes: Ct calling and expression normalization are downstream analysis fields.

source_steps.summary: Run a melt-curve ramp over all assay wells.
Record a structured qPCR readout with well, sample, gene, replicate, Ct, melt-peak, control, variability, and QC fields; quantitative normalization remains downstream analysis.

semantic_boundaries.label: Replicate layout metadata
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Replicate relationships are represented by well groups and readout schema fields; a first-class assay-design layer is left as a benchmark-derived extension point.

semantic_boundaries.label: qPCR quantitative analysis
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Ct calling and expression normalization are represented as structured result fields rather than computed by the wet-lab execution kernel.

paper_safe_claims: The case exercises a multi-stage workflow from sample preparation to structured qPCR readout.
Material state remains trackable across lysis, column cleanup, reverse transcription, plate loading, and qPCR setup.
The represented workflow completes all 344 generated active steps with zero diagnostics.
avoid_claiming: Do not claim that the kernel computes Ct values or fold changes.
Do not claim that the runtime predicts silica binding, reverse-transcription success, or amplification efficiency.
Do not claim first-class replicate semantics beyond declared well groups and schema fields.
